story_overview: On a night train, passengers including Clara, Nolan, and Simon interact, but strange events unfold as a doppelganger of Simon appears. The surreal journey continues with doppelgangers of Nolan and Arthur appearing in other locations. Meanwhile, Alice and Leo run frantically through a forest, and a bruised Clara is seen with Simon on a bus.

video_prompts:
Arthur: Older man wearing glasses and a brown jacket
The Railway Carriage: Interior of an older passenger train carriage with rows of upholstered seats, a central aisle with patterned carpeting, large side windows with curtains, and overhead metal luggage racks

Inside The Railway Carriage, the dark landscape blurs past the windows as the train travels at night. Arthur sits by a window, looking out at the passing darkness as the carriage's interior lights reflect in his glasses.

Leo: Man wearing glasses, light-colored pants, and dark boots.
Alice: Woman with short, wavy blonde hair, wearing a grey cardigan over a blue shirt.
Evan: Man wearing glasses.
Simon: Man with receding hair and wearing glasses.
View from behind Leo as he walks down the central aisle of the dimly lit The Railway Carriage at night. Alice, Evan, and Simon are seated, and some turn to watch Leo as he passes.

Clara: Woman with short brown hair.
Nolan: Man in his late 20s with an athletic build, a short, dark military-style haircut, and a clean-shaven, set jaw, wearing a dark navy blue tactical uniform with a combat shirt, matching cargo pants, a black plate carrier vest with pouches, and black combat boots.
the paper coffee cup: White paper coffee cup with a brown corrugated cardboard heat sleeve and a black plastic lid.
Inside The Railway Carriage at night, Clara walks down the aisle holding the paper coffee cup. She stops beside Nolan, who is sitting by the window. Clara hands the paper coffee cup to Nolan, who accepts it.
Inside The Railway Carriage, Clara sits down at a table next to Simon. Clara smiles as she settles into her seat. Clara holds the paper coffee cup and they start talking to each other.

Inside The Railway Carriage, Simon sits alone at a table, speaking animatedly to someone just off-screen. He gestures with his hands and laughs as he talks, with a paper coffee cup on the table in front of him.

the tactical assault rifle: Black tactical assault rifles with matte finishes, polymer stocks, and detachable box magazines.

At night, looking through a window into The City Bus, Clara sleeps with a noticeable bruise on her face, her head resting against the glass. Simon sits awake in the seat next to her, his gaze fixed forward, subtly shifting as the bus moves.
